CustomField.description: API name of an autolaunched Flow that returns a prefilled Form Submission on initial render. Set to Bypass (default) to disable. Extension packages register their prefill flows by adding picklist values via CCI metadata deploy.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: API name of an autolaunched Flow returning a prefilled Form_Submission__c. It must accept input 'record' (Form_Submission__c) and return output 'prefillRecord' (Form_Submission__c); optional 'prefillRelatedRecords' seeds related records. It runs last and only for a new submission, so 'record' already holds Prefill Template, source and URL parameter values. 'prefillRecord' merges field by field: set only what you want to change, because a blank field still clears the value.
CustomField.label: Prefill Flow
